notes: «حدثنا بذلك، قتيبة» read as part of the transmission verb; no previous report is in the context, so it is not a back-reference.
«عروة، وعمرة» are co-transmitters of ابن شهاب's line, meeting at عائشة (rule 2).
The scholars' opinions after the chain (سفيان الثوري، ابن المبارك، أحمد، إسحاق) are not routes of this saying.
